subQuests.subQuestName: Go to The Cat's Tail entrance

705390101.text: Looks like Margaret is talking with those two people over there.

705390102.text: Wait, is that Rosaria? Huh, she's standing next to an Adventurer Paimon doesn't recognize.

705390105.text: Say no more, Valerina. I'll continue to help you out, just as Victoria requested.

705390106.text: Look after the cats, check up on their health, give them a bath... These are all things well within my capabilities.

705390107.text: That doesn't solve our biggest problem, though, Miss Rosaria! The cats have been so anxious. If we can't get them to trust us...

705390108.text: They're sure to get sick from all the anxiety. We just opened, and the "Furball Fortress" is already about to go under!

705390109.text: Well, panicking certainly isn't going to solve the problem. The fact is, neither of us has a way with cats. That's not something I can change.

705390110.text: Hi, Rosaria! And hello to you too, Miss Adventurer!

705390111.text: Sounds like you are all really worried about something.

705390112.text: Our cat saviors! They've appeared already!

705390113.text: Eh... "Saviors"? Seems a bit sudden considering we just met...

705390201.text: Oh, it's just a regular house. Gotta say, Paimon was expecting something a little bigger with "Fortress" in the name and everything.

705390202.text: This was the biggest space I could find in the city over the past few weeks. The rent is cheap, so that's a plus. A half a year's worth of rent along with all the Cat's Tail-inspired furnishings only cost me a few million Mora.

705390203.text: Of course, not all of the cats will be staying indefinitely. We plan to offer some of the healthy ones up for adoption. As long as the new future owners prove capable and the cat seems like a good fit, they're welcome to take their new pet back to a loving home!

705390204.text: This location is definitely good enough. We could even expand the business one day and start sheltering stray dogs, foxes, or even squirrels! When that day comes, though, I'll probably have to think of a different name. Hmm, maybe the "Furball and Friends Fortress" would be a better fit, haha.

705390205.text: I would suggest letting all of this play out first. You still don't know if the customers will even get along with the strays.

705390206.text: Huh? Look over there! That cat is staring at us...

705390207.text: Oh, it's the little white cat! She's super afraid of people. She ran away when we tried to give her a bath. It took us forever to track her down again.

705390208.text: She looks so soft and clean, and her fur is so white and fluffy, just like fresh fallen snow. Wait, that's perfect! We should call her "Snowball"!

705390212.text: #Those are also some good names, {NICKNAME}, but Paimon thinks she likes "Snowball" best!

705390213.text: Here, kitty kitty. That's it, Snowball! Good kitty. That's a good kitty...

705390214.text: I—It's been, what, a minute? And you already got the cat to listen to you! Did you see that, Miss Rosaria? She's practically a miracle worker! You really are a cat whisperer...

705390215.text: That was nothing! They may be strays, but as long as you give them a good name and call on them with love, you're sure to gain their trust eventually!

705390216.text: First things first, though, you gotta pay attention to the way you interact with them. Hmm, how should Paimon put it... Basically, it all comes down to your demeanor!

705390217.text: For example, you can't just stand there trembling in fear, Valerina. If you're afraid, the cats are sure to become afraid as well! As for you, Rosaria, you might want to keep an eye on your, uh... facial expressions...

705390218.text: These poor creatures, picked up off the streets, given a name... and they now have a loving home. Fate is kind to even the lost souls who have wandered astray...

705390219.text: This city really has brought peace and happiness to us all.

705390221.text: Hey, Snowball is snuggling up to Rosaria! Looks like she's not afraid of her anymore!

705399901.text: Hmm, you know... We've encountered a lot of interesting animals lately!

705399902.text: But they're not exactly the types of animals you can play with. They're either super big or super... wet. Anyway, Paimon wants to play with something small, cute, and cuddly. Ooh, like a cat!

705399903.text: #How about we head to The Cat's Tail in Mondstadt and have a look around, {NICKNAME}?
